programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Breed has Luffy, Trafalgar, and Chopper firmly in his grasp with his Peto-Peto power! Breed dreams of a world in which he has enslaved all the humans, but Luffy's stubborn persistence and unwillingness to cooperate may have landed him in hot water.
programme.sub-title: Luffy Dies at Sea?! The Pirate Alliance Comes Apart!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Dressrosa! Luffy and the Straw Hats divide into teams and set about their business on this passionate, enchanting island! But here, in the heart of enemy territory, danger lurks around every corner. Luffy and the others encounter a mysterious blind man.
programme.sub-title: Explore! A Kingdom of Love and Passion - Dressrosa!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Out and about in Dressrosa, Luffy and his team encounter a mysterious and powerful blind gambler - and run into trouble while his shocking powers distract everyone! Meanwhile, a major event in the Colosseum draws huge crowds.
programme.sub-title: Full of Enthusiasm! The Corrida Colosseum!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro, Sanji, and Kin'emon strike off in search of the thieving fairy who has taken Zoro's sword, but Sanji finds himself mesmerized by the beautiful dancing of a gorgeous Dressrosa woman - with a deadly secret!
programme.sub-title: A Dangerous Love! The Dancer Girl - Violet!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy enters the Corrida Colosseum in order to compete for Ace's Flare-Flare Fruit! But with the mightiest warriors of the New World assembled and standing in his way, the competition will not be easy. The first stage of the competition is a battle royal.
programme.sub-title: A Formidable, Unknown Warrior! Here Comes Lucy!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the deadly battle of Block A winds down, all the onlookers in the stadium are shocked to discover the secret identity of the winner! Meanwhile, Luffy's cover may be blown as another voice from the past returns.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The battle heats up and the widely despised Bartolomeo takes the ring! But he'll have to contend with both the Prodence Kingdom contingent, and Dressrosa's own local favorite, Bellamy! From up above, Luffy risks having his cover blown!
programme.sub-title: A Super Rookie! Bartolomeo the Cannibal!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Don Chinjao continues to provoke Luffy, hoping to gain revenge against the grandson of his sworn enemy, Garp! But as the argument continues, Luffy risks having his cover blown, and his identity revealed! Meanwhile, the battle in Block B rages.
programme.sub-title: Big Names Duke It Out! The Heated Block B Battle!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The battle for Block B hits a crescendo as King Elizabello II prepares his devastating King Punch! But as the powerful attack becomes imminent, the Prodence Kingdom faction unravels! All that may be pointless, though.
programme.sub-title: A Deadly Blow! The Astonishing King Punch!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the handover team approaches Green Bit, they are attacked by the fearsome fish that live off the coast of Dressrosa. But that's the least of their problems as they find the bridge to Green Bit has collapsed!
programme.sub-title: The Fighting Fish Strike! Across the Deadly Iron Bridge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro tracks the thief who stole his sword - and learns about a danger facing the Straw Hats! Meanwhile, Law, Usopp, and the others arrive at Green Bit only to find it inhabited by strange creatures, and swarming with the Navy soldiers!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: All but done for, Sanji is trapped by Violet and her crew when she suddenly changes her mind and mysteriously turns on her own men! Meanwhile, Robin and Usopp come face to face with the Little People known as the Tontatta Tribe.
programme.sub-title: The Unknown World! The Tontatta Kingdom!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji gets in touch with Law in order to share a shocking secret - that could unsettle the Straw Hats' plans in Dressrosa for good! Meanwhile, Luffy's Block C battle begins, but will his Gum-Gum powers give him away?
programme.sub-title: The Stratagem of the Century! Doflamingo Makes His Move!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji and Franky try to regroup after Doflamingo's betrayal, hoping that destroying the factory is not yet out of their grasp. Meanwhile Luffy makes a friend in the Colosseum and Usopp ends up thrust into an uncomfortable position!
programme.sub-title: Shaking Heaven and Earth! Admiral Fujitora's Power!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Sunny is mysteriously deformed by the bizarre powers of Giolla! Can Nami, Chopper, and Brook act in time to save their beloved home? Meanwhile, the battle for Block C continues as Luffy suffers a staggering setback.
programme.sub-title: A Blow of Anger! A Giant vs. Lucy!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After knocking down the Giant, Hajrudin, as payback for what he did to Ucy, Luffy has to deal with Ideo, whose punch has the destructive force of a bomb, while the Funk Brothers show off their bizarre fighting technique.
programme.sub-title: Destruction Cannon Blasts! Lucy in Trouble!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami, Chopper, and Brooke keep trying to evade Jora and win back the Sunny even though it's been turned into a piece of art! In the Colosseum, Don Chin Jao finally faces Luffy - whose power will prove greater?
programme.sub-title: The Legendary Pirate! Don Chin Jao!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy stands along against Don Chinjao, and learns about the old grudge he bears against Garp! Meanwhile, Usopp and Robin get swept up in the Tontatta Kingdom's raid against the royal family, and Franky learns the eerie secret of Dressrosa.
programme.sub-title: Light and Shadow! Darkness behind Dressrosa!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Tontatta Kingdom gears up for its all-out assault on the Doflamingo Family, as Usopp and Robin are caught up in the war effort! Meanwhile, Franky arrives the headquarters of the toy movement where he finds Zoro, Nami & the others are cornered by Jora.
programme.sub-title: Making a Sortie! The Legendary Hero Usoland!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Don Chin Jao's hatred of Garp and Luffy is finally explained, while his battle against Luffy comes to an end. With tremendous power, one of them is squarely eliminated! But is that really the end of the Colosseum battle?
programme.sub-title: The Fierce Battle Coming to the End! Lucy vs. Chin Jao!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the battle with Don Chinjao long behind him, Luffy advances to the final round! Block-D contender Cavendish, however, takes the chance and pounces on Luffy, who is defended by an unlikely ally! The agenda of Colosseum gladiator Rebecca is exposed.
programme.sub-title: Luffy and the Gladiator of Fate - Rebecca!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Rebecca's deep bonds with the one-legged toy soldier are revealed! Her lineage can be traced to the previous ruler of Dressrosa - and her eternal bond with the damaged toy is linked to the violent overthrow of that regime by none other than Doflamingo!
programme.sub-title: Protect You to the End! Rebecca and the Toy Soldier!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As Rebecca enters the ring for the battle for Block D, the crowd shows its contempt for her heritage - only to be scolded by an unlikely supporter. Meanwhile, the other Straw Hats start to reassemble to deal with the attack on the Sunny.
programme.sub-title: The Last - and Bloodiest - Block! Block D Battle Begins!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Doflamingo recounts for Law the surprising history of the Don Quixote Family, while Nami and the others battle the insane and powerful artist, Giolla! Her ultimate attack renders them incapacitated, and prompts the betrayal of one of their closest allies!
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle! Giolla vs. the Straw Hats!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law is pinned by Fujitora, and Doflamingo has the upper hand! Only the most cunning of tricks could save Law's plan to hand Caesar over to Nami & the others! Meanwhile, the Sunny falls into danger again, & the battle for Block D heats up in the Colosseum.
programme.sub-title: Beautiful Sword! Cavendish of the White Horse!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Potato: Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Journey To The Purple Planet: Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Lost City: Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Meet Diego!: Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Save The Puppies: Woof! Woof! Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies." A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages. To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ¡Por Favor!: Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou - a cute and cuddly forest creature - who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Dino: Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island. It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs. Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots' Special Day: Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots most favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: To The South Pole: Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin! It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Pingüino all the way back home to the South Pole.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Game: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What Happens Next?: What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue: Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boot's Cuddly Dinosaur: It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Super Silly Fiesta: Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats and even silly dancing.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Fix-It Machine: Uh oh! Boots has a hole - un hoyo - in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baseball Boots: Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs - from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind, and snow!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Dora's cousin Daisy's 15th birthday party, her quinceañera! But the party can't start without Dora and Boots - they need to teach everybody the mambo!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's cousin Diego protects and defends all the animals in the rainforest. But in order to save a Baby Condor, Diego winds up trapped himself. And now he needs OUR help! ¡No te preocupes, Diego!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh no! Baby Jaguar's best friend, Baby Bear, is stuck on a ledge atop Bear Mountain - and the ledge is cracking! With Baby Jaguar leading the way, Dora, Boots, and Diego race to the rescue!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant wall, and all the way to the finish line.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: New World Order: Part 2: In their attempt to save Karai and take out the Foot Mystics and new Shredder, the Turtles wind up in a raging battle filled with magic and martial arts at Foot Headquarters.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Fathers and Sons: Weary after their first battle with the new Shredder, the Turtles doubt they can defeat him. To lift their spirits, Splinter shares a tale of the Turtles' toddler days.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Past Present: Shredder begins to build a new dynasty in New York, transforming the whole island into a hellish nightmare. The Turtles team up with Karai in a daring plan to direct Shredder's energy against him.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Enter the Dragons: Part 1: The demonic Shredder has transformed New York City into a nightmare version of feudal Japan and the rest of the world is next! But the Turtles have a plan…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Enter the Dragons: Part 2: The final showdown! With the help of allies and enemies alike, the Turtles have fought their way through a demonic version of New York to confront the Shredder once and for all!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Future Shellshock!: The Turtles and Splinter suddenly find themselves in a futuristic world of flying cars, multiple atmospheric and gravity zones and a "melting pot" population of humans and aliens. Who's responsible for this mess?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Obsolete: Hoping to fix the Time Window and return home, the Turtles sneak out with Cody and go to O'Neil Tech. However, Darius sees the guys and wants them away from Cody and in his lab for study!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Home Invasion: Raphael is impatient with the highly automated future - especially when Cody builds the Turtles a fancy new Dojo complete with realistic holographic simulation battle programs.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Headlock Prime: When he sees an ad for a pro-wrestling tournament, a homesick Raph can't resist. But the evening of fun is spoiled when TRIPLE THREAT, a banned wrestler with three bickering heads, crashes the arena.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Playtime's Over: Mikey, obsessed with the video game HELIX goes crackers when he finds out that the sequel is being released. The turtles need a guide to navigate the humongous LEVELLEX MALL, and enlist clueless Cody, who enlists street-wise Starlee.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Bishop to Knight: The guys are shocked to find that their old archenemy, Agent Bishop, is alive and well in the year 2105. And worse, he's President of the Pan-Galactic Council?!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Night of Sh'Okanabo: When Mikey finds out that Cody has never seen a horror flick, our boisterous movie aficionado drags Cody and his three brothers downtown for a little horror movie festival viewing.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Clash of the Turtle Titans: Mikey is shocked to discover someone has taken over his old super hero persona TURTLE TITAN. Insane with jealousy, Mikey tries to put the kibosh on the 22nd century imposter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Fly Me to the Moon: Cody and the Turtles go to the moon in search of a rare lunar alloy. But their quest is cut short when they discover that the Inuwashi Gunjin have been sent there by Darius Dun to make sure that they never come back alive.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Invasion of the Body Jacker: Jammerhead takes identity theft to whole new level when he gets his hands on the ultimate stealth device—The Bodyjacker! He uses it to take over Darius Dun's body!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Freaks Come Out at Night: After an outing downtown, Mikey starts behaving strangely -- as in super strength, green-slime-spewing strangely. The reason, the Turtles soon discover, is that Mikey has been "implanted" by one of Sh'Okanabo's "gene-seeds".

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Bad Blood: There are some new terrapins in town - the Dark Turtles: the psychotic clones of the original TMNT. They can match the boys kick for kick (or in Mikey's case, quip for quip).

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Journal: While rooting around in Cody's Trophy Room, Don, Leo, Mike and Raph come across the old "future history" journal kept by April O'Neil and Casey Jones.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Gaminator: The Turtles get their hands on a prototype game system called "The Gaminator," rumored to be the ultimate gaming experience. They get more than they bargained for when they are digitized and sucked into the game.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Graduation Day: Class of 2105: Splinter is pleased to announce that the Turtles are about to graduate from the ninja rank of Genin to the more advanced rank of Chunin.Everyone is excited until it is made clear that Michelangelo will not be graduating!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Timing is Everything: When Darius Dun and Sh'Okanabo join forces, it can only mean one thing—trouble! Anxious to test out their version of Cody's Time Window, Sh'Okanabo jumps the gun and unleashes a "Time storm" on NYC!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Enter the Jammerhead: Jammerhead busts his way out of prison, looking to even the score with his Turtle Nemeses. Thanks to a newly developed chip, he can download fighter footage) and instantly mimic the moves.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Milk Run: Intergalactic mercenary TORBIN ZIIXX returns and enlists the Turtles' help in smuggling a ship full of humanitarian aid past TRICERATON GANGSTERS. But the Triceratons are obsessed with finding Ziixx.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Fall of Darius Dunn: When Cody uncovers Darius Dunn's secret weapons manufacturing program, he and his uncle have a final showdown over who will ultimately control the vast O'Neil tech empire.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtle X-Tinction: Turtle X is on the rampage throughout New Manhattan - but Cody insists he has nothing to do with it. It turns out the fugitive Darius Dun planted a "Trojan Horse" virus in Cody's exo-armor and is now controlling Turtle X.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Race for Glory: The Turtles enter a tricked-out Hovershell in a cross-country road race that pits the latest high tech experimental vehicles against one another.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Head of State: When President Bishop is attacked by mysterious underground monsters, he enlists the help of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Our fearless green guardians must rescue Bishop before he loses his head to a figure from the Turtles' past.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: DNA is Thicker than Water: Darius comes down hard on the Darks and places the blame squarely on Dark Leo's spiky shoulders. To prove that he is an apt leader Dark Leo devises a plan to destroy the Turtles from within.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Cosmic Completist: Raphael has contempt for Michelangelo's geeky toy collection, but when the leader of the Inawashi Gunjin comes to the Turtles for help with a malevolent alien, Raphael must think like a geek to beat Aramzedo, the ultimate collector!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Day of Awakening: When the entire population of Moonbase Bishop goes missing, it appears that Sh'Okanabo has jump started his plan to take over the Earth.The Turtles stage an assault on the base, only to find a bigger, badder Sh'Okanabo!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Zixxth Sense: Torbin Zixx convinces the Turtles to help him recover an experimental matter transmitter that he was forced to give to Boss Zukko to pay off a debt. The fate of the world may rest on the success of their mission. But can they trust Zixx?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Tempus Fugit: When the Time Window is finally repaired, the Turtles enter into it to head home, but instead of finding themselves back in the lair, our heroes find themselves with Viral!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Karate Schooled: When the turtles are reunited with Casey and April, it's smiles all around … until it becomes clear that Casey's being brainwashed by his new martial arts instructor, Master Khan, a devoted Foot operative.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Something Wicked: The turtles' journey into cyberspace as Cybernauts on a mission to save as much of Master Splinter as they can find. But, they find far more than they're ready for. The Shredder! Born again. Inside the digital realm.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Engagement Ring: Casey and Raph head to Chinatown to find an engagement ring for April. They find one, all right. Too bad it has dark, transformational powers. Powers that are of interest to Hun and the Purple Dragons as well…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Hacking Stockman: While Don focuses on collecting Splinter's data bits, his brothers find themselves pulled into a war between The Foot and the Purple Dragons. But things get a lot worse when the cyber-Shredder finds a way out of the digital realm!

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Donatello teste un nouvel appareil sur April, censé mesurer ses pouvoirs psychiques. Mais par un phénomène étrange, elle se met à voir à travers les yeux d'un volatile mutant géant, mélange de lombric, d'oiseau, et de poisson.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Working out with iron; mining, extracting and forging this incredibly versatile metal; ultra-strong magnets; enhanced weapon technology; Martian mining.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The past, present and future of insulation technology.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Chrome hot rod; the Chrome Shop Mafia adds bling to truckers' big rigs in Missouri; Illinois' Arlington Plating Co. adds luster to auto parts; how Harley-Davidson puts chrome to work as both a decorative and protective feature of motorcycles.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels Essentials
programme.desc: From banishing waste to battling B-O, the modern bathroom is full of wonders, all devoted to keeping us clean.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Soft drinks, donuts, meat snacks, popcorn, and gum represent humanity's need to feed cravings; from handmade treats of earliest civilizations to hi-tech mass production, these snack foods evolved through history into modern manufacturing.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Digging up salt mining's history, from the "white gold" on the table to the oceanic and underground deposits whence it came; today people take salt for granted, but most life depends on it.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The construction of the 51-mile canal that took ten years to build and employed over 40,000 workers, 6,000 of whom died of yellow fever, malaria, and other horrors; an earlier, nine-year attempt by the French ended in failure and cost 20,000 lives.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Since 200 BC, when the Greek Philosopher Archimedes created a device for lifting water, the pump has been synonymous with transporting Earth's most precious resource.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.desc: When Sokka and Katara get too sick to travel, Aang goes out on his own to find a cure for them. But he is captured by Zhao and held prisoner inside an impenetrable fortress.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives - but they are so reliant that they are blind to the immanent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao’s Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn’t a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North, Part 1

programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North, Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marie says husband Ron has a violent temper & she fears her safety & of their 4-yr-old. She alleges Ron pushed her down the stairs & wrote "kill" on a bathroom mirror. Ron says Marie mixes her meds with alcohol. Dr. Phil cameras record the chaos at home.
programme.sub-title: Shocking Accusations: Abused Wife Or Abused Husband?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil digs into a heartbreaking story of a father's search for his missing daughter, then the loss of his grandchildren taken away by the man who may be guilty of their mother's disappearance. Don't miss this chilling tale that spans three generations.
programme.sub-title: What The Children Remember: Was Mommy Murdered

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ashley was sexually abused by her father from ages of 5 to 18, locked in a small camper, while giving birth to four of her father's children. In her first national interview since her father's arrest, the 22-year-old mom speaks about her horrible ordeal.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristle, Kayla & Patrick say mom Sherry has blown a $250,000 inheritance in 11 months, with $500 bar tabs & new motorcycles. But that's not it. They say mom takes non-prescribed pills, washes them down with rum & has pulled out a loaded gun while arguing.
programme.sub-title: A Blown Inheritance And Threats With A Loaded Gun: Our Mother Is Out Of Control

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter is boyfriend-obsessed and is damaging her promising future. Watch drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can married people be friends with someone of the opposite sex without sex getting in the way? At what point does a friendly relationship become an affair of the heart or emotional infidelity? Meet Randy, who says his wife, Amanda, has crossed that line.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They threaten, scream, intimidate and even bite. They are not tantrum-throwing tots ... they are bullying dads!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sarah, 46, has sent over $1 million to her boyfriend, “Chris,” whom she has only met online. She says she dreams about marriage, once he’s able to return to the U.S. from Africa. Dr. Phil’s Facebook followers joined the effort to track down the man!
programme.sub-title: I Believe My Cousin Is Squandering Her Inheritance On A Love Scam

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stacy and her boyfriend are accused of burning her 3-year-old daughter with cigarettes. What will lie detector tests reveal? Plus, Christina's mother has called CPS on her four times for allegedly abusing her grandson. Are Christina's kids in danger?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bob says his wife of 23 years, Dorothy, accuses him of cheating despite his denial. He says Dorothy has clawed his face, smashed windows & threatened to cut off his manhood, convinced he's been unfaithful. What does Bob say is the cause of her mistrust?
programme.sub-title: A Lying, Cheating, Violent Husband Or A Wife's False Accusations?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristen says two years ago she was manipulated into placing her newborn for adoption with her ex-stepfather Adam and his new wife, Stacy, who Kristen says promised she could remain in the child's life. Adam & Stacy insist they did everything by the book.
programme.sub-title: Adoption Nightmare: I Want My Baby Back

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Leah says mom Dora appears sweet but she's actually a narcissist, hypochondriac, drama queen & liar. Can this mother-daughter find common ground and rebuild? Plus Carrie says mom Paula, 61, has been meeting strangers online having sex. Dr. Phil weighs in.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're in difficult economic times & looking for ways to save money, start taking notes! Dr. Phil's guests offer tips to help save on clothes, utilities & vacations. Learn how to cut your grocery bill in half & how to entertain family inexpensively.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heather's son, Brandon, 15, died of an accidental overdose at her home; authorities say the teen swallowed & snorted Heather's morphine pills while drinking vodka and beer. Acquitted of charges, Heather says her ex-husband Brian continues to blame her.
programme.sub-title: Acquitted By A Jury But My Ex-Husband Still Thinks I'm Guilty Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mary says husband Jesse is abusive, unfaithful, controlling & she feels she's living in a prison. Jesse says he's not controlling, he's just "containing the beast," & his wife needs to abide by his rules if she wants to stay married. Dr. Sophy steps in.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you constantly have to compromise to get along with your mate? Do you feel like you have to give up a vital part of yourself to be in a relationship? Dr. Phil talks to controlling guests, and the loved ones who feel trapped by them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every parent can tell you that raising a child is often demanding, thankless, hard work. But when a teenager gets pregnant and has a child, the result can be stress and chaos.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say they have a moocher in their midst, but they don’t know how to kick this freeloader to the curb! Karen and Rex say they’re tired of their 24-year-old twins, Andrew and Justin, living under their roof.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They track your every move and monitor your conversations. This may sound like the latest GPS locator, but they are actually meddling moms!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tommy's 19-month-old son, Darby & 4-year-old stepdaughter, Kiera, mysteriously died three months apart. He says his ex-wife Julia & her new husband, Codey, killed them. Julia and Codey face their accusers. What do they believe happened to the children?
programme.sub-title: I Believe My Ex Murdered Our Children Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil offers to help a couple salvage their marriage in what resembles a real-life version of Cameron Diaz's movie, The Other Woman. Anna says Pablo cheats. Tensions run high when three women face Pablo. Dr. Phil enlists the help of Bishop T.D. Jakes.
programme.sub-title: My Husband Pablo And His Other Women

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The boys and girls reflect on the previous boy who was kicked out. When two new girls arrive in the villa, tensions begin to rise between the existing groups.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: Chris plays a dangerous game. Olivia prepares to pie Sam. Camilla sheds her inhibitions during a kissing challenge. Marcel and Gabby get closer.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The villa plays host to its most dramatic evening yet as Jessica's birthday party turns sour. Chris bins Chloe and Sam calls out Chris for his backstabbing behaviour. Later, Dom and Jessica escape to the hideaway.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: A debate over feminism leaves a question mark over Camilla and Jonny's relationship. Will Camilla accept Jonny's apology? Meanwhile, Marcel and Gabby enjoy their first kiss and Montana and Chloe worry about their future in the villa.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The girls get twerk-tastic for a new bootylicious challenge. Could Montana be the new girl for Sam? New boy Mike shakes things up.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: As the end of week two approaches, the heat is rising as the cast of young sexy singles vie for the 50,000 pound prize.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: Caroline Flack presents a feast of unseen moments and the very best of last week's action from the villa, featuring plenty of flirting, fighting, romance and juicy gossip.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The impending recoupling is all anyone can talk about. The islanders play a devilish game of truth or dare. Chloe stirs up some drama between Mike and Olivia.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The recoupling leaves Olivia tearful and torn between two guys. Chris calls out Mike on his behaviour. The latest challenge leads to some saucy revelations.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The love triangle between Chris, Olivia and Mike intensifies. Jonny and Camilla show off their sexpertise. Montana has a chat with Sam, but is he really listening?

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The islanders are left reeling when Caroline drops a bombshell. Mike makes a play for both Chloe and Amber. Will Olivia finally decide between Chris and Mike?

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The islanders are left reeling when Caroline drops a bombshell. Mike makes a play for both Chloe and Amber. Will Olivia finally decide between Chris and Mike?

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: Jessica and Mike's unexpected departure leaves the islanders - especially Dom and Olivia - in shock. Gabby chats to Amber about her feelings for Marcel as Olivia and Chris get back on track. Two new arrivals look set to shake things up.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: New arrivals Tyla and Simon waste no time in getting to know everyone. Are the cracks starting to show in Kem and Amber's relationship?

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: It is time to catch up on an action-packed third week in the villa, with loads more unseen action and all the best moments crammed into one jam-packed hour.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: It is now week four in the villa, and as the islanders swelter in the summer heat, the flirting, dating and daily dramas continue.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The couples face off in the Brits Abroad challenge. Amber grows jealous over Kem and Tyla's flirting. A shock double dumping rocks the island.

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: There is tension in the villa after Sam and Chloe's dumping last night. As a surprise recoupling is announced, the boys question if they are in the right couples.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Mac and Harm once again find themselves courtroom adversaries as Mac is assigned the difficult task of defending CPO Holst, an admitted wife abuser accused of murdering his wife's boyfriend.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Harm and Mac investigate the discovery of a skeleton found hidden aboard a decommissioned aircraft carrier that is being cut up for scrap, and learn it is all that remains of a long-missing JAG officer.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: The top female gunship pilot at the Yuma Marine Base is charged with disobeying an order to stop "fraternizing" with her crew chief, a married, enlisted man. Mac is assigned as prosecutor and Harm is set as Susan's defense attorney.
programme.sub-title: The Court Martial of Sandra Gilbert

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Having just stabbed a man on a street-corner, Willie, a wheelchair-bound former Vietnam POW arrives at JAG headquarters to report "a 30-year-old murder" which he's just committed. Willie relates that while imprisoned he knew Harm's father.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Concerns regarding the mysterious disappearance of a fully armed Navy F-14 during a storm lead Harm's investigation to consider such diverse scenarios as pilot suicide, terrorism, the Bermuda Triangle curse, or UFO interference.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Harm, Mac and Bud board an aircraft carrier in the Sea of Japan to investigate the accidental shooting down of a North Korean civilian airliner by Navy jets.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Harm and Bud investigate the crash of a Marine helicopter whose dead pilot is being blamed for the incident. They discover the chopper seems to have been hit by some form of UFO. Government security officials want to maintain a cover-up at all costs.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: Harm is arrested by the FBI for the murder of Konaplanik, a Russian who was selling Harm supposedly accurate information about his missing father's whereabouts. The killer turns out to be Col. Tomashevsky, a Russian agent.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: A woman Navy ensign shoots and kills a Turkish colonel; she claims self-defense.

programme.title: JAG
programme.desc: With help from Harm, Mac, Harriet, and Bud, Admiral Chedwiggen investigates the apparent suicide of his mentor, Admiral Clancy, who allegedly shot himself while on a hunting trip. Harm and company ultimately uncover who the killer was.

programme.title: JAG
